claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows SONY and PS4 logos on the unit.
Report explicitly states no controller is visible in either photo.

claims.claim: Comes with 10 games (FC 27, God of War 4, GTA 5, Spider-Man, Sekiro, Resident Evil 2 Remake, etc.)
claims.evidence: Report explicitly states no games, box, or accessories are visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (e.g. disc drive, HDMI port, overheating)
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on to the home screen and reading a disc

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown (500GB vs 1TB affects value)
risks.proof: Photo of the system settings storage screen or the capacity label on the console
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest common capacity

risks.risk: No accessories (controller, cables, games) actually present despite seller's claim
risks.proof: A single photo showing the console, one controller, power/HDMI cables, and the game discs together
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only, no accessories, no games

risks.risk: Games claimed may be digital licenses tied to seller's account rather than physical discs, which cannot transfer
risks.proof: Photo of the physical disc cases/discs themselves
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no games included

risks.risk: Cosmetic/internal wear not visible (dust, yellowing, sticker residue suggesting prior repair)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of vents, ports, and underside of console

proof_requests: Video of console powering on and loading a game from disc
Photo of system storage settings showing capacity
Photo of controller, cables, and all claimed game discs laid out together with the console
Close-up of console ports, vents, and serial number sticker
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a PS4 console, so it can be priced at worst case as a bare, unverified-condition unit with no accessories, since the seller's claims of a pad and ten games are directly contradicted by the photo report.
